title: Pass SP: blind annotation of the twelve core units (Claude Sonnet 5.5, unit packets only)
question: Does Sonnet 5.5 with unit packets only lose against the same model with golden inputs?
method: Fresh subagent with packet-only inputs identical to pass P's (only output paths changed); batches validated by code/s0_check.py; first versions kept.
commands: UV_PROJECT_ENVIRONMENT=$REPO/build/spike-venv uv run python code/s0_check.py results/s0/pass_sp --out results/s0/stored/pass_sp

agents.separation: fresh subagent; read only its input folder and output folder (transcript audit of every file opened, 2026-10-28); listed the file names in results/s0/ and code/ once, opening none; wrote only its output folder

conclusion: Twelve valid batches; five needed format repair after the first validation run.
